ig_caption:
RAG is an open-book exam for your AI 📖

🔎 Retrieve: find the notes closest to the question
➕ Augment: put them into the prompt
✍️ Generate: answer using only those notes

Real run on my demo vault (qwen2.5 3B + nomic-embed-text, local): it retrieves 2 notes and answers "30 days", citing the source.
The same model that knew nothing a minute ago. It just got the right pages at the right moment.

Part 3/5 of AI Second Brain. Ask me anything in the comments, I answer every one.
